title: Identify the IPC call that timed out during a relayed request on Tabgha
goal: Name the endpoint, process and method of the original 2026-11-05 timeout from a fresh reproduction on Tabgha, then fix it or give it an evidenced fitting limit with a regression that fails before the fix
acceptance: The banner or service log of a reproduction on Tabgha (Windows) names the endpoint, process, method and limit, or a stated owner reproduction shows no timeout
A committed regression reproduces the identified slow call and fails before the fix
No timeout is widened without measured evidence that the new limit fits; no assertion is weakened
privacy: Neutral repository fixtures only; the owner's reproduction on Tabgha is private evidence: only the banner text (endpoint, process, method, limit) is recorded, never chat text or base data
validation: Windows CI, since Tabgha is a Windows mini PC
escalation: Do not widen timeouts or weaken assertions to make tests pass
Park again with findings if the reproduction shows no timeout

effort.basis: Task added 2026-11-12 when B-008 was taken up, time box 2 h agent (the record's Small effort had no hours). About 1.5 h spent (stated: reading the relay and poll paths, history of the original message, a seeded poll measurement, Windows CI timing, records); parked without a cause. Remaining: 0.25 h owner to repeat the reproduction on Tabgha and paste the banner text, then 0.75 h agent to write the failing regression and fix or bound the named call, review and CI; more if the named call needs a design change. Estimate, not a measurement.
